questions.question: what is cloud computing?

options.text: Software installed on one personal computer

questions.question: Which organization published Special Publication 800-145, the widely accepted standard that defines cloud computing?

options.text: The US National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Microsoft Azure

questions.question: Which essential characteristic lets a user provision resources automatically without any human interaction with the provider?

On-demand self service
